changes: F401: separate bounded frame for the existing 1 KiB write workspace; storage ordering, total scratch size and frame limit unchanged.
SLEEP: PLL_SYS off; 48 MHz with USB, XOSC 12 MHz with both PLLs off without VBUS; minimal SLEEP_EN masks; RTC remains on XOSC/256.
Stock keyboard polled at about 80 ms while idle; USB insertion/removal restores/reselects clocks; full 125 MHz and bus timings restored on wake.
Optional CRC-framed clock sync without taking the display; automatic mode preserves an already configured RTC.
Desktop client discovers PicoCalc and activates by packet; unsupported STM32 kbd shell capability is not advertised by Pico.
Unconfigured RTC placeholder no longer becomes configured after a software reset.
limits: No independent battery-backed RTC exists on this Pico H board; complete power loss stops time. Desktop sync helps when a computer is available.

True DORMANT with keyboard wake and time continuity is not supported by the stock board/BIOS profile: keyboard events require I2C polling and there is no independent RTC clock. It needs an additional wake/time mechanism; a Pico H UF2 update alone cannot provide these signals.
Native M4/hard-float APP still require a Cortex-M0+/soft-float build; the existing CPU guard is intentional.
No battery discharge or whole-board current measurement was performed.
